paper_title: Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?
reason: 공급된 공식 자료만으로는 이 벤치마크 데이터의 라이선스, 상업적 이용, 수정·파생, 재배포 조건을 확정할 수 없어 게시하지 않습니다. 공식 저장소 README의 License 절은 'Project-authored software is released under the MIT License'라며 MIT를 소프트웨어에만 부여하고, 'Dataset images and annotations are distributed separately under mixed upstream terms; the software license does not relicense them'이라고 밝힙니다. 따라서 저장소 LICENSE 파일의 MIT는 코드 라이선스이며 데이터 라이선스가 아닙니다. 또 README에는 'LICENSE file' 절이 있어 '라이선스 미표기'에 해당하는 부재 증거 형식도 쓸 수 없습니다. 데이터 쪽 조건은 README가 안내한 Hugging Face 데이터 저장소(liuqa/Game2Real-Bench)의 benchmark/metadata/licensing.md, attribution.md, sources.tsv에 있으나 이번에 공급된 자료에는 포함되지 않았습니다. 논문은 실세계 400문항이 GQA, OmniSpatial, SPair-71k, Visual-Jigsaw, CAPTURe-real, All-Angles-Bench, IKEA Manuals at Work, SpatiaLQA, SSI-Bench, VisualTrans, ReasonMap 등 11개 출처에서 왔다고 밝힙니다(PDF 20쪽 Table 5). 이 출처들의 약관이 서로 다를 수 있으므로 각각 따로 점검해야 하며, 어느 한 조건으로 일괄 기재할 수 없습니다. 데이터 저장소의 licensing.md와 sources.tsv를 가져온 뒤 다시 제출해 주십시오.

screening.paper_title: Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?
screening.abstract: Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear whether abilities measured in toy games correspond to real-world visual reasoning and whether game examples can support transfer. We introduce Game2Real-Bench, a benchmark that studies these connections across four capability groups, including fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We construct 1,000 procedurally generated game samples with executable verification and curate 400 real-world samples aligned by shared reasoning requirements rather than visual similarity. We evaluate 25 representative VLMs and observe strong game-to-real consistency, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.935. We further study one-shot game-to-real transfer on four models. Constraint reasoning improves for several models, while fine-grained perception declines with game demonstrations. We also construct Game2Real-Dataset with nearly 24K verified game samples across 18 tasks and 65 QA families. Our benchmark, dataset, and code are available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench.
